name: Nova
source:
A mysterious spirit who helps the heroine regain her memories. He has a kind personality and takes great care of her, but he sometimes says deeply mysterious things.

He has the ability to obtain magical powers by fulfilling people's wishes.

[From AMNESIA World Official Fan Book]
